name: Do I need new cabinets, or can my existing ones be refaced?
description: Choose new cabinets if existing boxes are damaged or for layout changes; refacing is good for updating aesthetics if boxes are sound.

mainEntity.name: Do I need new cabinets, or can my existing ones be refaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need new cabinets or refacing depends on the condition of your current cabinet boxes and your desired aesthetic. If the existing frames are structurally sound, refacing can be a cost-effective option to update their appearance. This involves replacing doors, drawer fronts, and applying a new veneer to the existing boxes. If the boxes are damaged or you want a complete layout change, new cabinets are a better choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose new cabinets if existing boxes are damaged or for layout changes; refacing is good for updating aesthetics if boxes are sound.
